LanguageData.PersonalChronicle.UI.Guide.ButtonTip: Open the newcomer guide: a 13-step tour (workshop, devices, bills, dashboards)
LanguageData.PersonalChronicle.UI.Guide.Ask.Title: Start the newcomer tour?
LanguageData.PersonalChronicle.UI.Guide.Ask.Body: A step-by-step tour: painting a workshop zone, placing devices, adding a bill, and reading the manufacturing center. Two or three minutes; you can stop at any time and nothing is changed.
LanguageData.PersonalChronicle.UI.Guide.Ask.EscHint: You can leave at any time with ESC or the "Skip this step" button.
LanguageData.PersonalChronicle.UI.Guide.Tour2.Gate.Wo: Continues automatically once a workshop zone exists (or skip this step)
LanguageData.PersonalChronicle.UI.Guide.Tour2.Gate.De: Continues automatically once a workbench is built
LanguageData.PersonalChronicle.UI.Guide.Tour2.Gate.Bi: Continues automatically once a bill with ingredients exists
LanguageData.PersonalChronicle.UI.Guide.Tour2.Gate.Op: Continues automatically once the manufacturing center is open
LanguageData.PersonalChronicle.UI.Guide.Tour2.S0.Body: Each card is one system center. The initial centers (manufacturing / population / economy) carry live data; centers marked "reserved · not wired" show only their charter (duties and dependencies) - that is a roster entry, not a broken page.
LanguageData.PersonalChronicle.UI.Guide.Tour2.S1.Body: The top-right button restarts this tour at any time. While touring: ESC or "Skip this step" exits, "Back" steps one screen back, and the bubble follows whatever it points at.
LanguageData.PersonalChronicle.UI.Guide.Tour2.S2.Body: "Theme" switches the whole palette; every window of this mod follows it (the settings page lists each option's source and cost).
LanguageData.PersonalChronicle.UI.Guide.Tour2.S3.Body: The architect menu has been opened for you: click "Zones" -> "Workshop zone", then drag a rectangle where you want to produce (you can close this window with the X at its top).\nOrder matters: paint the zone first, place buildings second - workshop cells resist being dropped by later construction.
LanguageData.PersonalChronicle.UI.Guide.Tour2.S4.Body: The camera has been moved to your workshop (center of the screen) - build workbenches inside it: research bench, stove, tailoring bench, smelter; any production facility is assigned to the workshop it stands in.
LanguageData.PersonalChronicle.UI.Guide.Tour2.S5.Titl: Step 3: add a bill that consumes ingredients
LanguageData.PersonalChronicle.UI.Guide.Tour2.S5.Body: The camera is on the workbench inside your workshop (center of the screen) - click it -> "Add bill" -> pick a recipe that consumes ingredients (a simple meal, a piece of clothing). Only then does the manufacturing center's material rail have anything to list.
LanguageData.PersonalChronicle.UI.Guide.Tour2.S6.Body: The master control has been opened for you: click the manufacturing center card. The zone, the devices and the bill you just made all turn into readable numbers there.
LanguageData.PersonalChronicle.UI.Guide.Tour2.S7.Body: The left rail lists materials of the current bills: the number is the map-wide stock; below one craft's worth is marked red, and hovering shows "N per craft". It lists what bills need, not what the stockpile happens to hold.
LanguageData.PersonalChronicle.UI.Guide.Tour2.S8.Body: The right rail counts quality-bearing finished goods that sit inside workshop zones, grouped by vanilla quality tiers. Anything stored outside the workshops is not counted.
LanguageData.PersonalChronicle.UI.Guide.Tour2.S9.Body: "Layout" is the free-placement canvas: drag devices from the left palette onto the canvas; the layout is saved with the game, and clicking a device card opens its detail window. "View" is the read-only top-down plan.
LanguageData.PersonalChronicle.UI.Guide.Tour2.S10.Bod: Population: per-colonist archive (events, milestones, medals) plus "Career plan" (a recommendation, never forced). Economy: stock value and market trends. The remaining centers still read "reserved · not wired".
LanguageData.PersonalChronicle.UI.Guide.Tour2.S11.Bod: Click "Back" at the top-right to return to the registry - the first screen of this tour.
LanguageData.PersonalChronicle.UI.Guide.Tour2.S12.Bod: Two rules to remember: anything without data shows "—" (this mod never paints fake values), and every master-control screen has "Newcomer guide" at the top-right to replay this tour.
